set.body: Observed 2026-10-10 in worktree sf-phrf-s7: the worktree's sbt-warm server stopped responding and `python3 tools/build/sbt-warm <cmd>` reported exit 0 although the server had disconnected and the command had not run (the agent noticed, killed only that server's PID and reran the gates). tools/build/sbt-warm returns `subprocess.call(["sbt", "--client", command])` (line ~286), so it inherits the thin client's exit code; a disconnect can surface as 0. Risk: a gate reported green that never ran. Fix: make sbt-warm fail closed — e.g. require a positive completion signal from the server for each command (success/ error line, or query the server's last command result), treat client disconnect/EOF as failure, and add a unit test in tools/build/test_sbt_warm.py simulating a disconnecting client. Until fixed, agents should confirm test counts ("Passed: Total N") rather than trusting exit 0.
set.title: sbt-warm can report exit 0 when the sbt server disconnects
